visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: wide rounded body, broad rounded top block, centred round lens; matches the reference's proportions. The rejected drawing had a narrow block and a tiny lens.
omissions: The divider line under the top block is dropped so the lens can be r6 instead of r3; silhouette unchanged.
drawing_plan: HRECT_L outline x 4..44, y 16..40 with r4 corners; block x 12..36 up to y 8 with r3 corners; lens r6 at (24,25).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'camera': body with a raised top section and circle lens.
